sewaka.summary: A digital wedding assistant crafted for Indonesian traditional weddings—unifying budgets, vendors, QR guest check-ins, and cultural ceremony rundowns in one workspace.
modules: Digital Invites, RSVP & QR Guest Check-in

caseStudy.subject: Couples, extended families, & planners organizing traditional Indonesian weddings (Javanese, Sundanese, Minang, Madurese)
caseStudy.challenge: Planning traditional Indonesian weddings spans dozens of sacred rituals across extended families—from seserahan and siraman to midodareni and panggih—typically scattered across 5+ apps and spreadsheets, leading to budget blowouts and scheduling confusion.
caseStudy.solution: Sewaka unifies 6 core management modules (Checklists, Real-time Budgets, Vendors, Digital RSVP & QR Check-in, Timelines, Galleries) with 3 cultural modules (Seserahan Tracker, Cultural Rundown, Cultural Encyclopedia) across Free, Premium (IDR 99k/mo), and Enterprise tiers.
caseStudy.architecture: Next.js SaaS application equipped with Email/Password & Google OAuth authentication, Row-Level Security (RLS) for couple and family workspace isolation, and real-time progress and budget allocation tracking.
caseStudy.impact: According to published user case stories on the platform: up to 60 hours saved preparing seserahan, IDR 18 million saved against planned budgets through vendor swaps, and 100% on-schedule Day-H ceremony rundowns.
highlights: IDR 18M budget saved (Dewi & Andi · Madurese Custom)

scenarios.title: Rina & Budi (Jakarta · Javanese Custom)
scenarios.outcome: Saved 60 preparation hours on seserahan through structured checklists and collaborative tracking.

scenarios.title: Dewi & Andi (Surabaya · Madurese Custom)
scenarios.outcome: Saved IDR 18 million against their original budget by tracking allocations and swapping 3 vendors.

scenarios.title: Sari & Reza (Bandung · Sundanese Custom)
scenarios.outcome: Executed complex multi-family Day-H Sundanese ceremony rundowns 100% on schedule.

laku-pandai.summary: End-to-end agent banking infrastructure for commercial banks, regional banks (BPD), and BPRs—connecting Flutter field agent apps, Maker-Checker backoffice, and on-premise core banking adapters.
modules: Flutter Agent App + Hardware Key Binding
Backoffice Portal with SSO, RBAC & Maker-Checker

caseStudy.subject: Commercial Banks, Regional Banks (BPD) & BPRs — Branchless Banking Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Enterprise Architecture
caseStudy.challenge: Scaling field agent networks across low-signal regions risks double-debits or stuck UNKNOWN transactions, outlet location spoofing, agent float shortages, slow manual reconciliation, and unapproved fee or limit modifications.
caseStudy.solution: A 3-layer Control by Design architecture pairing a Flutter field agent mobile app (hardware-bound device keys & GPS/WiFi BSSID geofencing) with a Maker-Checker bank operations portal, 4-way reconciliation, and real-time operations cockpit.
caseStudy.architecture: On-premise container cluster (RHEL 9 Podman/Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift) across Primary DC + Hot Standby DRC, ISO 8583/20022/REST/SOAP Core Adapters, OAuth2/SAML IAM, SHA-256 hash-chained ledger, and zero-payload FCM wake signals.
caseStudy.impact: Enforces auditable banking control from day one: four-eyes segregation preventing self-approval on fees/limits, deterministic idempotency in weak connectivity, full data sovereignty in bank DC/DRC, and phased MVM-1 to MVM-2 delivery.
highlights: 6 built-in controls from Maker-Checker to SHA-256 ledger
ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST & SOAP Core Banking Adapters

scenarios.title: Outlet Geofencing & Hardware Key Binding
scenarios.outcome: Locks outlet operations within GPS/WiFi BSSID boundaries via Android Keystore / Secure Enclave mTLS keys.

scenarios.title: Transaction Certainty in Low Signal
scenarios.outcome: Idempotency guard with deterministic UNKNOWN resolution eliminates double-debits in field areas.

scenarios.title: Four-Eyes Governance & 4-Way Recon
scenarios.outcome: Maker-Checker fee/limit approvals paired with daily Matched/Mismatch/Missing transaction reconciliation.

vellumia.tagline: Where every story is written to be kept.

modules: Vertical Panel Episode Reader & Creator Tipping

caseStudy.subject: Indonesian serialized fiction readers & independent writers
caseStudy.challenge: Independent fiction writers struggle to build predictable recurring income on ad-cluttered platforms, while readers seek distraction-free reading, curated genre exploration, and clear mature-content controls.
caseStudy.solution: Vellumia combines a structured story catalog (Top-10 Trending carousel, 18 genre filters, daily release schedule, and a 26-author subscription directory) with a vertical-scroll episode reader and direct creator support.
caseStudy.architecture: Editorial paper-cream (#F7F1EA) Next.js web application implementing an aspect-[3/4] vertical panel reader shell, 18+ age-verification gating, and per-creator subscriber paywall overlays (currently live as an interactive public prototype).
caseStudy.impact: Validates a creator-first direct subscription model at IDR 15,000/month per writer with zero ads, integrating social engagement (Like, Save, Comment, Support writer) directly into the reading loop.
highlights: 18 curated genre filters & scheduled release calendar
Ad-free reading experience with 18+ content gating

scenarios.title: 18+ Gating & Subscriber Paywall
scenarios.outcome: Enforces age verification and subscriber-only episode gating seamlessly inside the web reader.

si-geomedik.tagline: Defense Geospatial & Healthcare Resource Information System
si-geomedik.summary: An authentication-gated geospatial portal for managing Indonesian Ministry of Defense healthcare facilities, medical personnel, medical equipment, and medical logistics with tiered RBAC.
si-geomedik.accessNote: This portal is login-gated for authorized personnel. This case study strictly reflects observed authentication architecture, RBAC roles, and security posture visible on the portal.
modules: Geospatial Inventory of Faskes & Medical Staff
HS256 Encrypted Sessions & SEC-07 Audit Trail

caseStudy.subject: Indonesian Ministry of Defense — Pusdatin, Ditkes Kuathan Verifiers, & Faskes/Kesdam Operators
caseStudy.challenge: Defense medical assets—encompassing healthcare facilities (Faskes), medical personnel, equipment, and medical logistics—are distributed across regional units, requiring centralized geospatial visibility, layered verification, and hardened access security.
caseStudy.solution: SI-GEOMEDIK separates duties across 3 defined organizational roles: Operator (Faskes/Kesdam) for unit data entry, Verifikator (Ditkes Kuathan) for verification, and Pusdatin as central Super Admin oversight.
caseStudy.architecture: Auth-gated personnel web portal secured by official email sign-in, HS256-encrypted sessions, Dynamic RBAC across all three command levels, and SUNDAWA SEC-07 compliant audit trails.
caseStudy.impact: Establishes a secure, accountable single-portal foundation for defense healthcare resource readiness and verification spanning regional clinics to central ministry oversight.
highlights: Unified scope: Faskes, HR, Medical Gear & Logistics
HS256 encrypted sessions & SUNDAWA SEC-07 Audit Trail

scenarios.title: Hierarchical Verification Workflow
scenarios.outcome: Regional Faskes/Kesdam updates pass through Ditkes Kuathan verification under central Pusdatin governance.

scenarios.title: Hardened Login-Gated Security Posture
scenarios.outcome: All geospatial inventories remain protected behind personnel auth with HS256 sessions and SEC-07 auditing.

nawasanga.name: Nawasanga
nawasanga.tagline: From every corner, one unified view.
nawasanga.summary: Enterprise intelligence platform for fleet fuel anti-fraud and automated Scope 1 GHG emissions accounting (ISO 14064-1 & POJK 51) built for logistics, heavy mining, plantations, and industrial fleets.
modules: Offline Driver Mobile PWA + GPS / ERP Webhooks

caseStudy.subject: Logistics Fleets, Heavy Mining, Palm Plantations & Industrial Operations (520+ Corporate Fleets)
caseStudy.challenge: Diesel theft—fake SPBU receipts, fuel siphoning, and over-tank billing—drains fleet budgets, while manual spreadsheet Scope 1 GHG audits for POJK 51 and ISO 14064-1 take up to 4 months per reporting cycle.
caseStudy.solution: Nawasanga combines an offline-ready Driver Mobile PWA (20-second receipt & odometer capture) with AI OCR verification, SPBU GPS geofencing, IPCC Tier-2 calculations (including B35/B40 biodiesel factors), and 1-click audit workpapers.
caseStudy.architecture: Multi-tenant enterprise platform with Row-Level Security, 5-level RBAC, GPS telematics integrations (Geotab, Cartrack, EasyGo), ERP webhooks (SAP/Oracle), and OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints.
caseStudy.impact: Featured platform case studies report 24.6% fuel leakage cut (IDR 840M/year saved) & audit prep shrunk from 4 months to 3 minutes at PT Nusantara Logistik Prima (420 trucks), and 14.2% HSD waste reduction (IDR 2.4B/quarter) at PT Borneo Prima Mining (280 units).
highlights: IDR 4.8B fuel leakage curbed across 520+ corporate fleets
32,400 Tons CO₂e audited · 100% POJK 51 & SIMPEL pass rate
ESG compliance dossier time reduced from 4 months to 3 mins

scenarios.title: PT Nusantara Logistik Prima (420 Trucks)
scenarios.outcome: Cut 24.6% fuel leakage (IDR 840M/yr saved, eliminated IDR 70M/mo fake receipts), 4 months → 3 mins audit prep, unlocked Green Financing.

scenarios.title: PT Borneo Prima Mining (280 Heavy Units)
scenarios.outcome: Reduced HSD waste by 14.2% (IDR 2.4B/quarter or 177,500 L/mo saved) with automated SIMPEL reporting & zero-finding PROPER Gold audit.

caseStudy.subject: Whoosh High-Speed Rail Travelers, Bandung Tourists, & Corporate Clients (/b2b)
caseStudy.challenge: High-speed rail passengers and family travelers frequently face steep cash security deposits, unclear weekday vs. weekend rate cards, and station pickup delays upon arrival.
caseStudy.solution: Abo Rent Car publishes transparent pricing across 14 vehicles (2022–2024 models, from IDR 275k/day self-drive or +IDR 200k/day chauffeur) with Zero Cash Deposit (KTP & SIM only), a Whoosh train-number & pickup calculator, and instant WhatsApp booking.
caseStudy.architecture: High-conversion web platform with vehicle category filtering, dynamic multi-day rate calculator with preset pickup hubs, dedicated /b2b corporate route, and 10-minute dispatch staging near Whoosh Padalarang.
caseStudy.impact: Maintains a 4.95/5 rating across 1,200+ renters with 100% on-time station pickups, 15-minute pre-arrival vehicle staging, and 5-minute KTP/SIM document handover.
